description: Change an error issue's status or assignee: resolve it (optionally in the release that ships the fix, or in the next release when it has not shipped yet, so a later occurrence reopens it as a regression), ignore it, reopen it, or assign it to a teammate. Only act on an issue when the user asked you to.

assignee.description: "me", a teammate's email, or "none" to unassign.

environment.description: With status "ignored" or "unresolved": act in this environment only (ignore it in staging, keep it live in production).

issueId.description: The issue id (from list_issues) or its Vinktar URL, as a person would paste it.

resolvedInNextRelease.description: With status "resolved": the fix has not shipped yet. The issue pins whichever release is seen next and only an occurrence on that release reopens it.

resolvedInRelease.description: With status "resolved": the release the fix ships in. Default: the last release it was seen in.

name: update_issue
title: Update issue
